Expiration now uses WorkRefreshApplication.mark_offer_expired -> WorkRefreshSqlRepository.mark_offer_expired to compare-and-set the database snapshot; savef(sync_snapshot=False) afterward writes only the JSON file projection. Refresh and claim also retain JSON projections, so the compatibility boundary is still open. The bank regex boundary now delegates bounded parsing, validation and orchestration to BankCommandApplication and result mapping to render_bank_reply; verified mutation receipts precede current account/configuration reads, the original four account writers retain atomic writes and snapshot CAS, and information queries remain read-only. This closes only the bank sub-boundary, not the matcher family. Media parsing and fallback retain legacy callbacks; group lifecycle notices remain a separate old event path. Keep the family blocked until every handler and remaining projection has a closed owner; do not add members automatically, and put out-of-scope discoveries in backlog for explicit review.
